reviews.method: Question, answer and source-span comparison; eight initial candidates rejected and replacements reviewed.
Compare question, answer and all original facts; restore necessary context, remove unsupported causal claims and ambiguous consistency labels; retain original IDs/questions/answers.
Compare question and answer with official related section and actual PDF parsed spans; complete one truncated explanation.
Read all 30 selected positive passages and all 20 negative-only sets; replace eight contexts and clarify 15 question scopes/answers. No independent semantic audit of every noise-variant distractor.
Targeted fictional documents with exact quoted facts and explicit expected behavior; not public-benchmark samples.

examples.issue: Hotel viewing is compatible with absence from sidelines; the upstream Yes label was misleading.
examples.resolution: Clarified contradiction question and explanatory No answer.

examples.issue: Both reports contain marital reflections; upstream answer selected only one.
examples.resolution: Answer both and require support from each.

examples.issue: Negative passages revealed February 4 without the year; full-string alias filtering missed this.
examples.resolution: Replaced both leaking passages with reviewed upstream negatives.

examples.issue: Passage supports full holiday-window box office, not the first-day result.
examples.resolution: Question now explicitly asks about the full window.

examples.issue: Mentioning a speaker did not establish director identity.
examples.resolution: Use another official positive passage explicitly stating directed by.

limitations: Assistant review is not independent human certification.
Public-derived items do not reproduce official leaderboard protocols.
No answer model, retrieval run, session run or state workflow was executed.
